responsibility: Implements GCC’s filename remapping subsystem for -fmacro-prefix-map, -fdebug-prefix-map, and -ffile-prefix-map. It parses OLD=NEW option arguments into linked mapping tables, keeps separate maps for macro expansion and debug-info consumers, and rewrites matching path prefixes into GC-allocated replacement strings so embedded source paths such as __FILE__ expansions and debug locations can be made reproducible or sanitized.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the file-prefix-map pair: it stores the linked mapping tables for -fmacro-prefix-map, -fdebug-prefix-map, and -ffile-prefix-map, parses OLD=NEW arguments, and rewrites filenames for macro and debug consumers. Unlike gcc/file-prefix-map.h, it is not just the exported API surface; it owns the mapping state and remapping logic.
